title: USC Hospitality: Residential Dining Meal Plans
text:
USC Hospitality: Residential Dining Meal Plans. Prices and rules below are for Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 unless noted.

SUMMER 2026
- Dining Dollar blocks of $250 or $500 are available to any student, with a 10% discount at purchase.
- Summer Dining Dollars do not roll over into Fall 2026.

ASSIGNMENT AND ELIGIBILITY (FALL 2026 / SPRING 2027)
- Plans are assigned by class standing. Students whose residence does not require a plan may opt into any plan.
- First-year students in University Housing are assigned the Cardinal Plan. They may upgrade to the Trojan Plan.
- Sophomores, juniors and seniors in USC Housing Apartments are assigned the Flex120 Plan when they confirm a USC Housing contract. They may upgrade.
- Graduate students are not required to buy a plan but may do so.

CHANGE DEADLINES
- Fall 2026: September 2, 2026 (passed as of November 2026).
- Spring 2027: January 21, 2027.

PLANS (price per semester)
- Cardinal, $4,219: unlimited residential dining hall swipes at all three halls; 7 guest swipes; one to-go meal per day; 2 Campus Center swipes per week (one per meal period).
- Trojan, $4,840: $4,840 in Dining Dollars, usable at residential dining halls or on-campus retail cafes. Declining balance.
- Flex120, $2,074: 120 meal swipes; $150 Dining Dollars; 7 guest swipes. Up to 6 swipes per day, one per meal period.
- Community 25, $500: 25 meal swipes; $50 Dining Dollars. Up to 6 swipes per day, one per meal period.
- Community 50, $960: 50 meal swipes; $100 Dining Dollars. Up to 6 swipes per day, one per meal period.
- Dining Dollar block: $250 or $500, added at any time during the semester at a 10% discount.

KEY RULES
- Cardinal Campus Center swipes reset every Sunday and do not roll over.
- Flex120 and Community plans allow one swipe per meal period, up to six per day. Guest swipes and Dining Dollars have no meal-period restrictions.
- Unused Flex120 balances are forfeited at semester's end. A new Flex120, Community 25 or Community 50 plan can be bought once the previous one is used up.
- Unused Dining Dollar blocks are forfeited on the last day of the semester.
- Plans can be purchased or changed through mycard.usc.edu. No contact information is listed on this page.
